content.stem: 在获取客户数据时,以下哪些可能是与金融犯罪相关的危险信号？(选择三项.)

options.A: 一位客户经常比要求时间早很多提交财务报表，显得过于急切
options.B: 客户坚持使用个人银行账户进行商业交易，尽管已被告知不应如此
options.C: 新客户倾向于尽量减少直接交流，主要依赖间接沟通方式，称其更方便或因时间限制所致
options.D: 该客户是一家上市公司，且业务非常多元化
options.E: 最终受益所有权不明确

content.stem_en: Which of the following are potential financial crime-related red flags when obtaining client data? (Choose three.)

options_en.A: A client frequently submits financial statements much earlier than required, appearing overly eager
options_en.B: A client insists on using a personal bank account for business transactions despite being advised otherwise
options_en.C: A new client shows a preference for minimal direct interaction and relies primarily on indirect communication methods, citing convenience or time constraints
options_en.D: The client is a publicly listed company with highly diversified operations
